The '''R37 Maintenance Droid''' was a type of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]]. R37s were among the diverse population of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stationed aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Field Secured Container Vessel|container train]] [[Black Ice/Legends|''Black Ice'']].<ref name="BI">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>
